beer.beer_description: The hand crafted Cargo India Pale Ale is jam packed with hoppy goodness. Dry hopped with Pacifica and Nelson Sauvin it is a vibrant beer with full-bodied flavours of citrus and stone fruit with a hint of caramel. The finish is long,expressive and bittersweet.
Our Pale Ale is easy drinking like the Cargo Lager and Pilsner but packed with citrus-laden Pacific Jade hops. It pours with an off-white head with big bubbles and an enticing aroma of hops and malt.

Light-bodied , smooth and well-balanced, the Cargo Pilsner is an all occasion beer which matches perfectly with a wide range of food. It has a hoppy, floral aroma with some malt leading into a soft mouthfeel before lingering with an intricate, dry finish.
Bright gold in colour and captivating in aroma, Cargo Lager is a refreshing and easy drinking premium lager which offers perfect balance between malt sweetness and mild hop bitterness.
Cargo Porter is packed with a roast malt flavour and sports a creamy tan head that lasts until the final drop. Silky smooth with a full body brimming with coffee, toffee and chocolate
English ale yeast adds​ fruity esters and NZ hops add a touch of pine and citrus to​ round out the crystal malts
Easy drinking strong, hoppy lager. Notes of pine, orange and a bouquet of tropical fruits. Limited release apart of the Lost Cargo series.
This is a nice light, slightly sweet apple cider
Hazy IPA
From thundering water comes the purest beer.
Notes of toasted graham cracker crust, vanilla, toffee with a slight nutty finish

Take on the double black diamond of ales with our American Pale Ale. Bursting with the bold hop character of Moutere, Wai-iti, and Pacifica hops and a grain-forward profile. It delivers a luscious, velvety mouthfeel, giving you the perfect ride from first sip to finish.

beer.beer_name: Hazy With A Chance of Lemons
beer.beer_description: Hazy with A Chance of Lemons, our 2025 Nelson Marchfest official release. Loaded with Zeus hops in the whirlpool, the beer is finished with a healthy dose of Southern Cross and Motueka hops to bring the summer lemon flavours forward.

beer.beer_name: All Glory To Garston Southern IPA
beer.beer_description: All Glory to Garston, our 2025 Battle of the Southern IPAs official submission. Starting with a base of Pilsner, Chocolate, and Brown malt, this beer is continuously hopped with Nelson Sauvin and Rakau by Garston Hops to highlight all the beauty that the area has to offer.

Light-bodied , smooth and well-balanced, the Cargo Pilsner is an all occasion beer which matches perfectly with a wide range of food. It has a hoppy, floral aroma with some malt leading into a soft mouthfeel before lingering with an intricate, dry finish.
